DIAG_CELLA_UB_UNINIT_TRY: Give it a value when you declare it, for example int total = 0;

DIAG_CELLA_UB_DIV_ZERO_TRY: Check the divisor with an if before dividing.
DIAG_CELLA_UB_BOUNDS_WHY: An array only has the slots you declared, numbered from 0; past the last one is someone else's memory.

DIAG_CELLA_UB_PAST_END_WHY: There is nothing past the end of a container; using it is like going outside an array.
DIAG_CELLA_UB_PAST_END_TRY: Make sure the loop or iterator stops before end().
DIAG_CELLA_UB_OVERFLOW_WHY: An int has a maximum (about 2.1 billion); going past it breaks the result.
DIAG_CELLA_UB_OVERFLOW_TRY: Use long long when numbers can get large.
DIAG_CELLA_UB_OVERLAP_WHY: When source and destination overlap, copying overwrites parts not yet copied.
DIAG_CELLA_UB_OVERLAP_TRY: Copy into another variable first, then assign it back.

DIAG_CELLA_UB_PIN_TRY: Use a pin that exists on this board (see its pin map).

DIAG_STREAM_OPERATOR_SUGGEST_WHY: cout sends things out with <<, cin reads things in with >>; the direction is fixed.
DIAG_CELLA_NOT_ASSIGNABLE_WHY: = means "put the right side into the left side"; the left side must be a place that can hold a value, like a variable.
DIAG_CELLA_NOT_ASSIGNABLE_TRY: Move the calculation to the right, for example c = a + b;
DIAG_CELLA_CALL_ARGUMENTS_WHY: The arguments of a call must match the parameters of the function in number and type.

DIAG_CELLA_RETURN_VALUE_WHY: The return type decides whether return carries a value, and which.
DIAG_CELLA_RETURN_VALUE_TRY: A void function writes just return; others must return a value on every path.
DIAG_CELLA_OPERAND_TYPES_WHY: Not every type supports every operation; a string cannot be multiplied by a number.
DIAG_CELLA_OPERAND_TYPES_TRY: Convert the value to a type that supports it, or use another operation.
DIAG_CELLA_NO_CONVERSION_WHY: There is no automatic conversion between these two types.
DIAG_CELLA_NO_CONVERSION_TRY: Use a value of the expected type, or change the variable's type.

DIAG_SYNTAX_GAP_LIKELY_TRY: Add `;` at the end of this line. If it is still wrong, check whether the line itself is complete.
DIAG_SYNTAX_OUTSIDE_FUNCTION_CODE: This line is outside any function
DIAG_SYNTAX_OUTSIDE_FUNCTION_WHY: Statements such as `cout`, assignments and `if` can only go inside a function's braces; outside, the program never knows when to run them.
DIAG_SYNTAX_OUTSIDE_FUNCTION_TRY: Move this line into the braces of `main` (or of the function that should run it).
DIAG_VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE_WHY: This board setting only accepts values in range; others are ignored.
DIAG_VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE_TRY: Use a number within the range.
DIAG_BAD_NAME_EMPTY_WHY: A name is the only way to refer to it later.
DIAG_BAD_NAME_EMPTY_TRY: Type a name in that field.
DIAG_CELLA_REJECT_WHY: C++ has rules for how each statement is written; breaking them means it does not compile.
DIAG_CELLA_REJECT_TRY: Compare with the same construct in the lesson or an example.
DIAG_CELLA_TERMINATION_WHY: The program ends here, so the rest does not run.
DIAG_CELLA_TERMINATION_TRY: Check why it ends here, for example an exception nobody catches.
DIAG_CELLA_ORDER_UNCOMPARED_WHY: Two things in one statement affect each other, and the standard does not fix which goes first.
DIAG_CELLA_ORDER_UNCOMPARED_TRY: Split them into two statements to fix the order.
RUNTIME_ERR_UB_FLOW_OFF_END: Stopped here: function reaches its end without return ({clause})
DIAG_CELLA_UB_FLOW_OFF_END_BLOCK: Function reaches its end without return
DIAG_CELLA_UB_FLOW_OFF_END_CODE: Flowing off the end of a function that returns a value
DIAG_CELLA_UB_FLOW_OFF_END_BLOCK_AT: '{subject}' has a return type but reaches its end without return
DIAG_CELLA_UB_FLOW_OFF_END_CODE_AT: line {line}: '{subject}' has a return type but reaches its end without return
DIAG_CELLA_UB_FLOW_OFF_END_WHY: A function with a return type promises to hand back a value. In C++, reaching the end without a return is undefined behavior, even if the caller ignores the value.
DIAG_CELLA_UB_FLOW_OFF_END_TRY: Make sure every path ends with a return, for example add return 0; at the end, or change the return type to void if it does not need to return anything.
PROPOSAL_STALE: The program changed after this proposal was sent; the place it points to is gone or different — it can only be rejected.
PROPOSAL_BUSY: Syncing — press Accept again in a moment
PROPOSAL_REPLACED_LESSON: the lesson loaded its starting program
LANG_DIFFERS: the rewritten program gives a different result on this input
